attempts.summary: Built and verified the PostgreSQL HA service. Node1 routes lan-a and lan-b using persisted VyOS configuration. Patroni and a three-member etcd quorum manage PostgreSQL 16 on node2-node4. Node2 was the initial primary; after tested failovers and sequential restarts, node4 is the current writable leader with node2 and node3 streaming at zero lag. appdb is replicated across all members. All four nodes completed the mandatory restart protocol with changed boot identities and recovered health.
